session_summary: Follow-up session focused on reviewing the status of the between-session task (listing school costs) and practicing a new step regarding consent-sensitive contact with a trusted adult. The mentor facilitated an in-session activity to model the contact process, but no external support was delivered or verified.
primary_concern: Uncertainty regarding household budget details, support eligibility, and the specific school processes required to access help; the main barrier remains unresolved as the student reports fluctuating difficulty depending on how well they can plan ahead.
